_README: Your curated, quick-access works. List identifiers as "SOURCE:doc_id" (the same code shown in the Works Library). These pin to a Featured strip at the top of the Works Library; everything else collapses under 'All works' with a toggle. Edit freely and rebuild. (Note: writings promoted to books via assign-canon-ids.py — Jasher, the Testaments, etc. — now live in the book dropdown, not here.)
